opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to sign up at the OneCoin website and then purchase or update packages, including upgrades identified as 1000. It displays Premium Trader and Tycoon Trader packages priced at €12,500 and €5,000, tied to mining, cryptocurrency, and daily OLP points, while selected packages reward OneCoin Tokens placed into an exchange account. The process also introduces a transaction password for withdrawing money expected from the business. Although initial account creation is described as free, the pathway leads from registration toward substantial paid upgrades and anticipated business earnings.
